name: journal
description: a leather-bound journal. the final entry, written in shaky handwriting: 'the skull is the key. take it to the altar in the crypt beneath the graveyard. but be warned — the doors will seal behind those who dare disturb the firstborn's rest. i have seen what happens to those who try to leave. god forgive me, i cannot stay. — augustus blackwood, october 30th, 1891'
